prompt:
A minimalist recipe card illustration for lavender bedtime tea. Flat-lay top-down view of a single hand-thrown ceramic cup filled with pale lilac lavender tea, placed slightly off-center (lower left). Scattered around the cup on a bone #F7EFE2 surface: three small bundles of dried lavender stems with violet-purple buds, a few loose lavender buds, and one tiny silver moon ornament. The composition breathes — at least half the image is clean empty bone-colored surface. No utensils, no saucers, no text, no steam.

RENDERING STYLE: Clean modern illustration — flat base colors with smooth soft-shaded gradients. Lavender stems and buds have clean confident silhouettes, NOT painterly. NO watercolor bleeds, NO paper grain, NO sketchy lines. The cup has a subtle violet glazed rim. Cool diffuse evening light from upper left casts a soft purple-tinted shadow below the cup. Feels calming, dusk, getting-ready-for-bed. Recipe card thumbnail — subject must read at small sizes.
